source_acquisition.pdf_method: Full-document PyMuPDF fitz 1.27.2.3 extraction, page.get_text('text') for every page, with --- PDF PAGE N --- markers.

reading.source: David Pollard, Empirical Processes: Theory and Applications (1990)
reading.range: PDF pp. 9-64; printed pp. 1-56; introduction and complete §§1-10.
reading.anchors: Symmetrization Theorem 2.2; Rademacher chaining and entropy Theorem 3.5; VC/packing §§4-5; manageability and uniform laws §§7-8; outer convergence/representation §9; finite-dimensional convergence plus stochastic equicontinuity and functional CLT §10. Application chapters §§11-14 were not read.

reading.source: Jon A. Wellner, Empirical Processes: Theory and Applications (2005 corrected course-note version)
reading.range: PDF pp. 3-84; printed pp. 1-82; complete Chapter 1 §§1-10.
reading.anchors: Weak process convergence/chaining §§2-4; symmetrization §5; GC and Donsker criteria §§6-7; VC and approximation entropy §§8-9. Multiplier section §10 also read. Chapter 2 pp. 85-131 was extracted but not read.

reading.source: Philippe Rigollet and Jan-Christian Hütter, High-Dimensional Statistics: Lecture Notes (MIT 18.657, arXiv:2310.19244v1)
reading.range: PDF pp. 8-127; introduction and complete Chapters 1-4.
reading.anchors: Concentration, MGF/tail inequalities, finite maxima and epsilon nets Ch. 1; fixed-design least squares, sparse/BIC/Lasso/Slope risk bounds Chs. 2-3; minimax risk and two-point/Fano/packing/Assouad-related lower bounds Ch. 4. Chapter 5 onward was not read.

reading.source: John Duchi, Lecture Notes on Statistics and Information Theory (Stanford, PDF dated 2023-12-06)
reading.range: PDF pp. 179-199 and 207-210; complete Chapter 8 §§8.1-8.5 and §8.7.
reading.anchors: Minimax and excess risk, testing reduction, TV/KL/Pinsker, Le Cam, Fano including distance-based forms, Assouad and global Fano. Section 8.6, §8.8 and the rest of the 495-page PDF were not read.

reading.source: David Pollard, Probability tools, tricks, and miracles (unpublished author manuscript, version 2026-06-22)
reading.range: PDF and printed pp. 223-347; complete Chapters 10-14.
reading.anchors: Classical chaining and entropy §§10.1-10.8; majorizing measures/weighted and admissible partitions Ch. 11; Gaussian majorizing measure lower/upper methods Ch. 12; product-space/Rademacher symmetrization and oscillation Ch. 13; VC shatter/packing and Haussler bounds Ch. 14. Other chapters were not read. The author's §12.4 warning that the assembled proof may contain errors is retained.

library_inspection.statistics_specific_pages_or_items: None found. Foundations-01's current dossier proposes the only statistical experiment/estimator/loss/risk interface required by this work.
missing_minimal_prerequisites: Sub-Gaussian/sub-exponential Orlicz definitions, independent-sum Hoeffding/Bernstein bounds, finite maxima and finite-dimensional net bounds.
Class-indexed empirical/Rademacher process definitions, outer-measurability convention, and independent-process symmetrization/contraction.
Covering/packing/bracketing entropy, Dudley chaining and VC metric-entropy bounds.
Uniform GC/ULLN criterion and empirical-risk oracle inequality.
Process-space outer weak convergence, asymptotic equicontinuity, Donsker/FCLT criterion and entropy-based sufficient theorem.
Testing-to-minimax reductions by Le Cam, Fano and Assouad with KL/TV conventions.
Projection, sparse least-squares, BIC and Lasso risk upper bounds with fitted-value loss, noise and design assumptions explicit.

validation: Parsed sources.json with Python json and checked five sources/paper page counts.
For each source, verified full extraction markers equal the PDF page count and recorded PDF/text SHA-256, byte counts, line counts and character counts.
Read each identified local supplier body and recorded the boundary between existing foundations and absent statistics/empirical-process results.
No tests, commits, pushes, workflow changes or files outside this role's dossier and scratch source cache were changed.
